apikeys_subtitle: Create and revoke keys for machine clients
apikeys_manager_helper: Keys authenticate machine clients against the Facet API with the Authorization: Bearer header. Each key acts as one of your roles.
apikeys_empty: No API keys yet. Create one to let a machine client call the Facet API.
apikeys_revoke_confirm_body: Clients using this key stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
apikeys_create_error: Could not create the API key
apikeys_revoke_error: Could not revoke the API key
apikeys_new_helper: Name the key and pick the role it acts as. The key inherits the role's grants — it cannot do more than the role allows. The raw key is shown once after creation.
apikeys_new_name_helper: A label only you see. Up to {max} characters.
apikeys_new_role_placeholder: Pick the role this key acts as
apikeys_new_role_helper: Must be one of your assigned roles.
apikeys_new_expires_helper: Leave empty for a key that never expires.
apikeys_new_expires_error: The expiry must be in the future.
apikeys_reveal_helper: Copy this key now — it is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later. If you lose it, create a new key.
webhooks_subtitle: Deliver signed event envelopes to your receivers
webhooks_manager_helper: A webhook watches one doctype and POSTs a signed envelope to your URL on every event. Deliveries act with your account and active role — the role must be able to read the watched documents.
webhooks_empty: No webhooks yet. Create one to push events to an HTTPS receiver.
webhooks_delete_confirm_body: The receiver stops receiving events. Deliveries already queued still run.
webhooks_secret_copy_aria: Copy webhook signing secret to clipboard
webhooks_new_helper: Point the webhook at a doctype and an HTTPS URL. The secret is generated for you and signs every delivery — configure your receiver to verify the X-Facet-Signature header.
webhooks_url_helper: HTTPS URL that receives the signed envelope. HTTP is accepted only when the server allows insecure targets.
webhooks_source_helper: Every event on this doctype is a delivery candidate.
webhooks_all_events_helper: Off: only the listed events fire the webhook.
webhooks_headers_helper: Optional headers merged into every POST — useful for receiver-side authentication. Keys starting with X-Facet- are rejected.
webhooks_header_key_error: Header names may use letters, digits and - _ . only
webhooks_header_facet_error: Headers starting with X-Facet- are reserved
webhooks_calls_load_error: Could not load the call log
webhooks_replay_queued: Replay queued — the new attempt appears in the log when it runs.
webhooks_calls_empty: No calls yet. Deliveries and test probes land here.
webhooks_test_helper: Sends one signed test envelope to the target URL now. The receiver's answer is shown as data — any status is a result.
mcp_helper: Connect an MCP-capable agent to Facet with one of these URLs. Each endpoint acts as one of your roles; the agent authenticates through the OAuth flow on first connect.
mcp_empty: None of your roles expose an MCP endpoint.
sessions_helper: Devices and apps signed in as you. Revoking a session stops its refresh — an access token already issued stays valid until it expires.
sessions_revoke_confirm_body: The device or app signs out at its next refresh. This cannot be undone.
sessions_bulk_confirm_body: Every other device and app signs out at its next refresh. Your current session stays signed in.
configure_domains_list_subtitle: A domain owns its schema, doctypes, and access grants. Published domains are live; drafts are staging copies you publish when ready.
configure_domains_explain_configure_text: Grants, labels, replication targets, and settings. Applies to the live domain immediately.
configure_domains_explain_draft_text: Adding, renaming, or removing doctypes and fields. Live data keeps running until you publish.
configure_domains_empty: No domains yet — branch from a published domain, or create an empty draft with New empty domain.
configure_domains_draft_confirm: Discard draft “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
configure_domains_network_delete_error: Network error — could not delete domain
configure_domains_discard_helper: Discarding removes the draft's doctype definitions and all draft data. The audit log keeps the draft's history. This can't be undone.
configure_domains_danger_helper: Deleting the domain removes its doctype definitions, every document in it, and its views. The audit log keeps the domain's history. This can't be undone.
configure_domains_layout_fallback: The saved layout could not be read — showing the computed layout.
configure_domains_grants_helper: Authorizes consumer domains to replicate specific fields from doctypes in this domain. A consumer only receives data for source records that one of its own records references.
configure_domains_fields_empty: Select a source doctype to list its fields.
configure_domains_grant_wildcard_error: Wildcard '*' cannot be combined with explicit field names
configure_domains_grants_empty: No replication grants. This domain doesn't expose fields to consumers.
configure_domains_context_sets_helper: Domain-owned queries that resolve a dynamic value set per request. Named scopes reference these via $<name>.
configure_domains_context_sets_empty: No context sets. Named scopes cannot use dynamic value sets.
configure_domains_editors_helper: Accounts on this list can edit this domain's definition: the domain document, its doctypes, and their views. Any editor can draft a new domain and becomes that draft's first editor. Only administrators can change this list.
configure_domains_editors_add_placeholde: Add an editor to this domain…
configure_domains_editors_empty: No editors on this domain yet. The account that creates a draft domain becomes its first editor.
configure_domains_editors_all_listed: Every account is on this list already.
configure_domains_editors_system_note: The application manages the system domains. They have no editor list.
configure_domains_check_helper: Aggregated warnings from each doctype in this draft domain. Cross-doctype configurations (references, replication grants, children, composition) are surfaced here rather than at authoring time — the runtime silently skips broken configs, so these are warnings, not blockers.
configure_domains_check_ok: No problems detected — ready to publish.
configure_domains_check_notices_helper: Informational defaults — the runtime behaves gracefully without them; no action required.
configure_domains_delete_dialog_desc: Deletes the domain {id} and everything it owns — doctype definitions, every document, and views. The audit log keeps the domain's history. This can't be undone.
configure_domains_import_desc: Upload a domain bundle (.zip or .tar.gz) exported from a Facet instance. The bundle carries the domain's definitions — doctypes and views, no document data. It creates a new domain, or updates an existing one with merge enabled.
configure_domains_bundle_invalid: The bundle must be a .zip or .tar.gz file.
configure_domains_bundle_into_helper: Optional — leave empty to keep the bundle's source domain name.
configure_domains_bundle_merge_helper: Update the domain's definitions when it already exists. Without merge, an existing target refuses the import.
configure_domains_bundle_importing: Importing the bundle — the result lands in your notifications.
configure_publish_desc: Copies the draft's structure (doctype defs + domain doc) into a real-named domain and drops the draft. The draft's data is discarded — see the audit log for the draft's history. If the target domain already exists, the draft's doctype definitions replace the live ones when their structure changed only if each changed doctype bumps its schema version and carries a migration entry.
configure_publish_underscore_error: Names starting with `_` are reserved for drafts.
configure_publish_invalid_error: Must be lowercase alphanumeric (a-z, 0-9, -) and start with a letter.
configure_publish_name_helper: Lowercase alphanumeric (a-z, 0-9, -), starting with a letter.
configure_publish_warnings_note: Warnings describe configurations the runtime silently skips — publishing is allowed but you may want to review them first.
configure_publish_ok_note: No problems detected. Ready to publish.
configure_publish_import_documents_desc: Carries the documents of the selected doctypes into the published domain. Documents of other doctypes are discarded with the draft.
configure_publish_import_documents_exist: Already exists on the target — not imported
configure_publish_conflict_desc: A live domain named `{name}` already exists. Publishing over it replaces the live definitions; structural changes still require a schema version bump.
configure_publish_report_desc: Published as {domain}. The publish filed or updated grant tickets under the producer domains your definitions pull from:
configure_publish_ticket_filed: New grant filed — the producer's acceptance is needed before data flows.
configure_publish_ticket_filed_active: New grant filed and accepted — data can flow.
configure_publish_ticket_merged: Existing grant widened with the new resources.
configure_publish_ticket_dropped: This grant was active and is now inactive — the widened contract needs the producer's re-acceptance.
configure_publish_ticket_untagged: An edge pulls untagged fields — every untagged field of that doctype flows once the grant is active.
configure_grants_issued_helper: Data-sharing contracts this domain issues: each grant names one consumer domain and the resources (your doctypes and field tags) it may read. You hold the consent — edit the resources, then activate the grant to open the gates.
configure_grants_held_helper: Grants other domains have filed in this domain's favour. Read-only — the producer owns the contract.
configure_grants_new_helper: The grant is filed inactive — a ticket awaiting your acceptance. Give it resources, then activate.
configure_grants_resources_helper: A source field flows when the grant is active, its doctype has an entry, and the field's tags share a name with the entry. Untagged fields carry the 'default' tag.
configure_grants_resources_empty: No resources yet — the grant admits nothing until you add an entry per doctype.
configure_grants_row_tags_error: Each resource entry needs at least one tag — 'default' admits the doctype's untagged fields.
configure_grants_row_doctype_error: Pick a doctype or clear the tags — an entry without a doctype admits nothing.
configure_grants_issued_empty: No issued grants. This domain shares nothing with other domains yet.
configure_grants_held_empty: No held access. Other domains have not filed a grant for this domain.
configure_doctypes_published_note: This doctype is part of a published domain.
configure_doctypes_cascade_note: Cascade — deleting a {doctype} deletes its {child}. Reachable both standalone and scoped (access derives from parent).
configure_doctypes_unique_helper: No two documents can carry the same value for this field.
configure_doctypes_display_name_helper: Rendered as each document's display label. A field reference interpolates that field's value — the placeholder shows the form.
configure_doctypes_search_helper: Rendered as each document's search text. A field reference interpolates that field's value — the placeholder shows the form.
configure_doctypes_templates_reproject_h: A template change applies to new documents only. Existing documents keep the old label and search text until you reproject the doctype — use Re-project derived columns on the Platform maintenance page.
configure_doctypes_key_helper: Lowercase letters, digits, underscores — start with a letter
configure_doctypes_tags_helper: Roles whose visible_tags don't include these see the field masked, and cross-domain grants flow the field only when their entry names one of its tags. Empty means 'default' — the tag every role has and grants reach unless narrowed.
configure_doctypes_field_editor_empty: Select a field from the left to edit its properties.
configure_doctypes_reference_note: A reference points at an independent root — no cascade. {doctype} keeps its own lifecycle and access rule.
configure_doctypes_compute_note: Read-only. Value is derived by the Lua function and recomputed whenever its dependencies change. Not directly editable.
configure_doctypes_object_note: Embedded object. Stored inline in the record — no identity, no endpoint of its own, loaded and saved with the parent. Reach for a child collection instead when the elements need their own identity, lifecycle or access scope.
configure_doctypes_array_note: Embedded array. Stored inline in the record — no identity, no endpoint of its own, loaded and saved with the parent.
configure_doctypes_mode_helper: A secret stores no default value — its content is only a marker.
configure_doctypes_not_filterable_note: Not filterable. A {type} field declares no filter capabilities — it cannot be used in list filters or gain an index.
configure_label_helper: Shown instead of “{name}” across the interface. Leave empty to keep the name.
configure_plural_label_helper: Plural noun used on app consent screens, e.g. “contacts”. Leave empty to use a simple plural of the name.
configure_doctypes_migrations_helper: Each entry maps a source schema version to a Lua function. Documents below the definition version run the gap functions in order on read. Declare migrations together with a schema version bump — the server rejects a same-version save that carries them.
configure_doctypes_icon_helper: No icon set — falls back to the diamond.
configure_doctypes_danger_helper: Deleting the doctype orphans every {doctype} record and its children. This can't be undone.
configure_doctypes_badge_defined_aria: This kind has a stored core.DocumentView template
configure_doctypes_badge_fallback_aria: No stored template — a default fallback is rendered here
configure_doctypes_views_empty_hint: This doctype has no stored views. Each kind previews a fallback template generated from the doctype definition. Switch to Edit to author the view.
configure_doctypes_views_empty_hint_read: This doctype has no stored views. Each kind previews a fallback template generated from the doctype definition.
configure_doctypes_views_template_not_ob: a template must be a JSON object
configure_doctypes_legend_inline: Single-row inline preview used inside relations and tables
configure_doctypes_legend_card: Narrow card — assistant document cards and kanban surfaces
configure_doctypes_legend_quickview: Narrow peek-drawer surface — opened from list/table clicks
configure_apps_subtitle: Registered clients that can call your API on someone's behalf. Activate a draft, or open the detail to edit its grants.
configure_apps_empty_sub: An app gets a client ID, a sign-in address, and a set of permissions it may ask people to grant. Pick a shape to start from.
configure_apps_preset_web_desc: Runs on your own domain. Facet handles sign-in and the API.
configure_apps_preset_backend_desc: Has a backend. Signs in through the consent screen, and can also act as itself with an API key.
configure_apps_registry_unreachable: Could not reach the app registry.
configure_apps_no_draft_error: No in-progress app. Start again from the setup step.
configure_apps_draft_missing_error: The in-progress app draft could not be found.
configure_apps_draft_banner: This app is a draft — complete the wizard to make it usable.
configure_apps_cli_note: Deploys run from the facet CLI — not yet released. From your build folder, one command uploads and activates a revision. Until then you can upload a build from here.
configure_apps_slug_helper: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Immutable after creation.
configure_apps_client_helper: public signs in through OAuth (PKCE, consent screen); confidential adds a backend component that can also act as itself through an app-owned API key.
configure_apps_redirect_helper: Absolute http(s) URIs. A '*' port on an http loopback host (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1) matches any port.
configure_apps_origins_helper: Bare origins (scheme + host + optional port) permitted for CORS.
configure_apps_role_ids_helper: Metadata only — filters the launcher, never consulted during authorization.
configure_apps_headless_helper: For headless registrations such as a CLI tool: the launcher never shows the app, and the deploy route refuses it — an app marked "no asset" cannot carry a host.
configure_apps_host_helper: Exact hostname Facet serves this app's active deployment at. Bare lowercase name — no scheme, port, path, or wildcards. DNS and TLS certificates are your deployment stack's responsibility (nginx or Caddy). A change applies at once and the previous host stops answering; empty clears the host.
configure_apps_host_helper_no_asset: Not available: an app marked "no asset" is never served, so it cannot carry a host. Turn off "Not a deploy target" first.
configure_apps_assistant_helper: Lets this app open chat conversations with the Facet assistant. A change applies from the next message.
configure_apps_assistant_prompt_placehol: Extra instructions for this app's assistant…
configure_apps_assistant_prompt_helper: Optional. Sent to the assistant as this app's own instructions. A change reaches new conversations only.
configure_apps_no_key: No active key. Generate one to let the app call the API as its service identity.
configure_apps_key_needs_role: No active key. Pick a service role first — the app needs one to call the API.
configure_apps_regenerate_confirm: Regenerate the API key? The current key stops working immediately.
configure_apps_revoke_confirm: Revoke the API key? Clients using it stop working immediately.
configure_apps_deploy_note: Deploys usually run from the facet CLI — not yet released. One command uploads your build folder and activates it. This page does the same thing by hand.
configure_apps_spa_toggle: Serve as SPA (unknown paths fall back to index.html)
configure_apps_setup_page_title: New app · Set it up · Configure · Facet
configure_apps_slug_taken: This slug is already in use.
configure_apps_owner_helper: The iam.Account that owns this registration.
configure_apps_origins_wizard_helper: Bare origins permitted for CORS on the token endpoint and the API.
configure_apps_redirect_wizard_helper: Absolute URIs the app may redirect to after authorization. Exact-match only.
configure_apps_redirect_warn: ⚠ Origin not in the allowed-origins list.
configure_apps_draft_hint: Saved as a draft — nothing is live until you publish.
configure_apps_service_role_helper: The service account authenticates as exactly this role. Effective permission is the app's grants ∩ the role.
configure_apps_pick_service_role: Pick a service role to continue.
configure_apps_role_no_api_channel: This role's connectivity does not list the 'api' channel. Key issuance will refuse until the channel is on the role.
configure_apps_review_sub: Everything except the address can be changed after publishing.
configure_apps_logo_missing_detail: The consent screen will show initials instead. Does not block publishing. Logo upload is a follow-up.
configure_apps_consent_footer: You can decline any of these.
configure_apps_consent_sensitive: Contact data includes fields marked sensitive — access is logged.
configure_apps_consent_empty: This app has not requested any permissions yet.
configure_apps_live_public_sub: Copy these into your app. You can find them again on the app page.
configure_apps_live_backend_sub: Generate the API key and copy it. It is shown only once.
configure_apps_no_secret_body: Browser apps can't keep one. This app uses PKCE and DPoP-bound tokens instead — nothing here is confidential.
configure_apps_issue_body: The app calls the API as its service identity with a bearer key.
configure_apps_test_signin_note: The "test sign-in" action is a follow-up — it opens the real consent screen so you can verify the round-trip before writing any code.
configure_currencies_subtitle: The money registry. Active rows are selectable in money fields; inactive rows keep working where a value already holds them.
configure_roles_subtitle: Application-global roles. Pick a role to edit its per-doctype permissions.
configure_role_details_subtitle: Edit this role's level, description, and connectivity channels. The role name is unique and immutable.
configure_role_tags_helper: A field is visible to this role when its tags are all listed here. A new tag must already be visible to you or to this role.
configure_role_tags_union_error: Not allowed: {tags}. A new tag must already be visible to you or to this role.
configure_role_tags_required: Keep at least one tag — an empty list hides every field from this role.
configure_role_channels_helper: Programmatic channels this role may use. Empty = a workplace-only role (the core application and hosted apps only).
configure_role_budget_helper: Maximum assistant tokens per account over a rolling 30-day window. The largest budget across the account's enabling roles applies. Check Unlimited to leave the cap off.
configure_role_members_subtitle: Accounts assigned to this role. Add or remove members below.
configure_role_members_all_assigned: Every account is already a member of this role.
configure_role_grants_subtitle: Per-doctype permissions granted by this role. Toggle actions and scopes per doctype.
configure_assignments_subtitle: Pick a role to see its members, or pick an account to see its roles. Toggle membership with the add / remove controls.
configure_assignments_add_account_placeh: Add an account to this role…
configure_assignments_members_empty: No members yet. Add one above.
configure_assignments_pick_role_hint: Pick a role above to see its members.
configure_assignments_add_role_placehold: Add a role to this account…
configure_assignments_roles_empty: No roles assigned. Add one above.
configure_assignments_pick_account_hint: Pick an account above to see its roles.
configure_assignments_default_role_aria: This is the account's default role
configure_accounts_subtitle: People and service identities. Open an account to manage its credentials.
audit_page_subtitle: Append-only event log. Every mutation recorded with actor, time, and target state.
audit_forbidden: You do not have permission to view the global audit log.
audit_load_error: Failed to load the audit log.
audit_block_snapshot: Snapshots already reflect the document state.
audit_block_newest: This is the newest mutation of the document — rollback would be a no-op.
audit_block_permission: You do not have update permission on this document type.
audit_history_empty: No mutations recorded for this document yet.
audit_select_mutation_hint: Select a mutation to inspect its changes.
audit_no_changes_recorded: No structured changes recorded for this mutation.
audit_detail_missing_mutation: The mutation in this link is not in the loaded history. It may be too old, or the link is not valid.
audit_restore_title: Restores the document to its state before this delete
audit_cluster_button: Roll back the whole action ({changes} changes on {documents} documents)
audit_cluster_button_title: Restores every document the action touched to its pre-action state
audit_confirm_cluster_desc_singular: This will undo the whole action: {changes} change across {documents} documents. Every document is restored to the state it had before the action; documents created by the action are deleted. Later changes to these documents are overwritten.
audit_confirm_cluster_desc_plural: This will undo the whole action: {changes} changes across {documents} documents. Every document is restored to the state it had before the action; documents created by the action are deleted. Later changes to these documents are overwritten.
audit_confirm_delete_desc: This will restore {doctype} (document {doc_id}) to the state recorded by the mutation before this delete (mutation {mutation}, # {idx}). A new snapshot mutation will be written to the audit log.
audit_confirm_update_desc: This will restore {doctype} (document {doc_id}) to the state recorded by mutation {mutation} (# {idx}). A new snapshot mutation will be written to the audit log.
audit_change_redacted_helper: The server hid this value. Your role cannot see this field.
platform_indexes_page_subtitle: PostgreSQL index tracking. One row per managed index, with its build status.
platform_indexes_forbidden: You do not have permission to view index status.
platform_maintenance_page_subtitle: Rebuild derived data and run version migrations for one doctype. Every processed document gains one audit log row.
platform_maintenance_forbidden: You do not have permission to run doctype maintenance.
platform_maintenance_load_error: Failed to load the maintenance state.
platform_maintenance_status_empty_hint: Select a doctype to see its maintenance state.
platform_maintenance_action_reproject_de: Recomputes the derived columns of every document of this doctype.
platform_maintenance_action_migrate_desc: Migrates documents that sit below the current doctype version.
platform_maintenance_confirm_body: Every processed document gains one audit log row. Run this job during low traffic.
platform_maintenance_jobs_empty: No maintenance jobs for this doctype yet.
platform_artifacts_page_subtitle: Stored files across every domain. Inspect live grants and see where each file is referenced.
platform_artifacts_forbidden: You do not have permission to view the artifact store.
platform_artifacts_detail_empty: Select an artifact to inspect its grants and references.
platform_artifacts_grants_empty: No grant has been minted for this artifact.
platform_artifacts_revoke_confirm_messag: Every URL minted under this grant stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
platform_artifacts_revoke_forbidden: You do not have permission to revoke grants.
platform_artifacts_detail_load_error: Failed to load the artifact details.
platform_artifacts_download_aria: Open or download {filename} in a new tab
platform_artifacts_purge_confirm_message: The file, every download URL, and all provenance are destroyed now. This cannot be undone. Documents that reference the file keep a dead link.
platform_artifacts_purge_reason_placehol: Why is this file being deleted?
platform_artifacts_purge_forbidden: You do not have permission to force delete artifacts.
platform_artifacts_purge_error: Failed to force delete the artifact.
admin_new_role_helper: Name the role. Use lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (e.g. content_editor). The role starts with no permissions — add them in the editor.
admin_new_role_name_error: Must start with a letter; only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.

dashboard_new_domain_helper: The label is shown across the interface; the id becomes the domain's permanent name at publish. The draft itself keeps a temporary id.
dashboard_new_domain_id_helper: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; starts with a letter. The id is permanent once the domain is published.

doc_template_no_field: Template error: {type} node has no field binding
doc_template_dotted_field: Template error: {type} node uses a dotted field binding '{field}' — wrap the top-level field in an 'object' node and bind the bare sub-field
doc_template_missing: Template error: the template node is missing
doc_document_missing: Template error: the document is missing

doc_input_auto_object: Template error: the 'input' node cannot edit the object field '{field}' — wrap an 'object' node around it and bind the bare sub-field

doc_input_auto_computed: Template error: the 'input' node cannot edit the computed field '{field}' — computed fields are read-only
doc_input_auto_replicated: This field is populated by replication and is read-only.

form_select_no_match: No exact match. Pick an option from the list.
period_order_exclusive: Start must be strictly before end (bounds are '[)' — exclusive upper)
period_order_inclusive: Start must be on or before end (bounds are '[]' — inclusive both ends)
doc_money_invalid: Amount must be a decimal number (e.g. 9.99)
doc_structured_invalid_json: Invalid JSON. Fix the syntax before you save.

doc_color_hex_error: Not a valid hex color — use six hex digits, like #5B8DEF.

list_editor_personal_edit_helper: Visible only to you. General↔personal cannot be changed after creation.
list_editor_general_edit_helper: Shared with everyone. General↔personal cannot be changed after creation.
list_editor_personal_warn: Your account id is unavailable — the personal view may not bind to you.
list_editor_inline_helper: Columns marked Inline edit toggle their boolean value directly in the table — the viewer needs update permission on the doctype.
list_editor_no_columns: No columns — add one from the left
list_editor_date_helper: The field that anchors each document on the calendar grid.
list_editor_end_date_helper: Optional second date field to form a range.
list_editor_end_date_capability: This field has no comparison filter capability — it cannot serve as the range end. Add `filters: [comparison]` to the field and re-deploy.
list_editor_color_helper: Optional field that drives chip colour.
list_editor_filters_helper: Only documents matching all active filters are shown.
list_editor_kanban_mode_values_desc: One lane per value of the chosen field.
list_editor_kanban_mode_custom_desc: Define each lane with its own filter.
list_editor_group_by_helper: Each value of this field becomes a lane.

list_editor_lane_filter_required: Choose a field, operator, and value

list_editor_lanes_all_hidden: At least one lane must stay visible
list_editor_kanban_allow_move_helper: Users with update permission can drag cards between lanes.
list_editor_kanban_sort_helper: Orders the cards inside every lane. Defaults to Updated, newest first.
list_editor_grid_frozen_helper: The leading columns stay pinned at the left edge while the rest scroll.
list_editor_grid_allow_create_helper: Show a ghost row that creates a document directly in the grid. The viewer also needs the create permission.
list_editor_grid_columns_editable_helper: Every writable column is editable in the grid unless you uncheck Edit — the viewer still needs update permission on the doctype. Read-only columns show their value and open the peek drawer.
list_editor_grid_summary_helper: Adds the column's aggregate to the Σ row — the total runs over the whole filtered set, not just the loaded page.
list_editor_grid_unknown_field: This field no longer exists in the doctype — remove the column.
list_editor_grid_sort_helper: Orders the rows. Defaults to Updated, newest first.

system_settings_page_subtitle: Runtime platform configuration — the AI assistant, outbound mail, artifact serving, and data retention. A change reaches every process without a restart.
system_settings_forbidden: You do not have permission to view the platform settings.
system_settings_load_error: Failed to load the system settings.
system_settings_group_assistant_note: AI assistant connection. Endpoint, key, model, and sampling resolve together at every turn start — existing conversations switch on their next message.
system_settings_group_mail_note: Outbound email connector. A change rebuilds the mail adapter before the next send.
system_settings_group_artifacts_note: File storage serving. A new link TTL applies to links minted after the save. The prune window applies at the next prune run.
system_settings_group_retention_note: How long the platform keeps edit history and deleted content. A change applies at the next daily pass.
system_settings_group_localization_note: Instance defaults every account follows until it picks its own values. The personal settings page shows them as the server default.
system_settings_localization_timezone_he: IANA zone for accounts without their own timezone, or Automatic to follow each account's browser. Empty follows the file (auto).
system_settings_localization_language_he: Language for accounts without their own language. Empty follows the file (en).
system_settings_group_security_note: Authentication policy: multi-factor enforcement and the login paths the instance accepts. A change applies to the next login; existing sessions stay valid.
system_settings_mfa_type_helper: 'totp' enables TOTP; 'none' turns MFA off. Enrolled accounts keep their factor data, so re-enabling reactivates it. Empty follows the file.
system_settings_mfa_enforcement_helper: 'preferred' asks but never blocks; 'required' holds every un-enrolled login at enrollment. Empty follows the file.
system_settings_auth_mode_helper: 'SSO only' removes the password path: login, password reset, and first-credential setup refuse. Saving it needs at least one enabled provider. Recovery: facet auth:mode hybrid. Empty follows the file (hybrid).
system_settings_credential_link_ttl_help: Seconds a credential link stays valid: the password-reset link, the invite link, and the first-credential change token share one window. A change applies to links sent after the save. Empty follows the file — default 86400 (one day).
system_settings_provision_roles_helper: Roles assigned to every account created automatically through federated login when its provider sets no default role — for example an 'employee' role. A save refuses a role that does not exist. Empty means no baseline: only providers with their own default role can provision.
system_settings_provision_roles_add_help: Search picks one role and adds it to the list.
system_settings_provision_roles_empty: No baseline — only providers with their own default role can provision.
configure_oidc_subtitle: OpenID Connect providers for federated login (Keycloak, Okta, ...). The client secret is stored sealed and is never shown again.
configure_oidc_load_fallback: Could not load the identity providers
configure_oidc_empty: No identity providers configured. Federated login is off until one is added and enabled.
configure_oidc_delete_message: The provider is tombstoned. Accounts keep their links, but the name cannot be re-created while the deleted provider holds it.
configure_oidc_field_name_helper: URL segment in /auth/oidc/. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
configure_oidc_name_immutable: The name is fixed after creation.
configure_oidc_field_secret_helper: Stored sealed; typed at save, shown as set/not-set afterwards. Leave empty on edit to keep the stored one.
configure_oidc_field_domains_helper: Comma-separated allowlist (e.g. example.test). Empty allows link-based login only.
configure_oidc_field_role_helper: Qualified role id (iam.Roles.editor) for JIT-provisioned accounts. Required when auto-provision is on.
configure_oidc_field_scopes_helper: Comma-separated. Defaults to openid, email, profile.
system_settings_mail_smtp_heading_note: Used only when the adapter is smtp.
system_settings_assistant_name_helper: Display name shown on every assistant surface — the workspace and builder windows and the top-bar pill. Empty follows the file (default: Assistant).
system_settings_assistant_endpoint_helpe: OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL. Resolved with the model and the key at every turn start.
system_settings_assistant_model_helper: Model identifier, for example gpt-4o. Applies from every conversation's next turn. Same-provider switches are the verified path.
system_settings_assistant_prompt_helper: Instructions appended to the end of the workspace and builder prompts when a conversation starts. Empty means no custom instructions.
system_settings_assistant_max_tokens_hel: Completion token cap per turn. Empty follows the file — the default is no cap.
system_settings_assistant_temperature_he: Sampling temperature, 0.0 to 2.0. Checked at save time. Empty follows the file — the provider default applies.
system_settings_assistant_max_history_he: Conversation turns kept in context. Empty means unlimited.
system_settings_assistant_auto_tools_hel: When on, registered tools run without a confirmation round-trip. Default: on.
system_settings_assistant_api_key_helper: Never displayed — set or not set. Type a new key and save; clearing returns to the file value.
system_settings_assistant_test_note: Sends one minimal completion through the saved assistant settings — the same path a chat turn takes. Save any pending change first; the test uses the saved settings.
system_settings_assistant_test_unsaved: Save your changes first — the test uses the saved settings.
system_settings_mail_adapter_helper: none turns email off — Facet will not send. smtp delivers through the SMTP settings below. Switching to smtp requires a saved host, and none is refused in production.
system_settings_mail_test_note: Delivers one email through the saved connector — the same path password resets and invites take. Save any pending change first; the test uses the saved settings.
system_settings_mail_test_recipient_help: Address that receives the probe. Empty follows the file's from address.
system_settings_mail_test_unsaved: Save your changes first — the test uses the saved connector.
system_settings_mail_from_name_helper: Display name on the From header.
system_settings_mail_smtp_host_helper: SMTP server hostname. Required when the adapter is smtp.
system_settings_mail_smtp_port_helper: SMTP server port, 1 to 65535. File default: 587.
system_settings_mail_smtp_username_helpe: SMTP auth username. Empty for unauthenticated relays.
system_settings_mail_smtp_password_helpe: Never displayed — set or not set. Type a new password and save; clearing returns to the file value.
system_settings_mail_smtp_tls_helper: Upgrade the connection with STARTTLS after connecting.
system_settings_artifact_adapter_helper: Fixed at deployment. The storage adapter wires at boot from the config file. Existing artifact bytes stay in the previous backend. Change artifact.storage in the config file and restart.
system_settings_artifact_grant_ttl_helpe: Seconds a signed download link stays valid. Applies to documents and images. Empty follows the file — default 3600 (one hour).
system_settings_artifact_grant_ttl_media: Seconds a signed link stays valid for audio and video. Keeps playback alive when the listener seeks. Empty follows the file — default 21600 (six hours).
system_settings_artifact_grant_prune_hel: Days an expired signed-link row stays before the prune deletes it. The window counts from the link's expiry. Zero keeps every expired grant forever. Empty follows the file — default 7.
system_settings_artifact_prune_helper: Days an artifact stays safe after its last reference ends. After that, the prune run can delete it. Zero keeps every artifact forever. Empty follows the file — default 30.
system_settings_retention_mutations_help: Days of edit history kept per document. Older entries fold into one snapshot. Rollback past the window answers 404. Zero keeps history forever. Empty follows the file — default 180.
system_settings_retention_tombstones_hel: Days a deleted document keeps its content, so audit views can read it. After that, the prune clears the content. Zero keeps every payload forever. Empty follows the file — default 30.
system_settings_reset_title: Clear the pin: the value returns to the config file's on next save
system_settings_secret_set: set — type a new value to rotate
welcome_save_error: Could not save the setting. The tour will show again on your next sign-in.
welcome_pitch_body: Welcome to Facet. Facet is a governance layer for your organization's data: structure your information as typed documents, control who may read and change it, and keep a verifiable record of every change.
welcome_pitch_art_aria: Typed documents wrapped in a governance layer, locked, with a chain of change records
welcome_domains_body: A domain holds one business area — CRM, HR, projects. Create your first domain from scratch, or import a bundle from another Facet instance.
welcome_domains_art_aria: Two domains: CRM created from scratch, HR imported from a bundle
welcome_builder_body: Doctypes define your records: typed fields, references between records, and the views your team works in. Shape them in the Builder — iterate on a draft, publish when ready. The Builder assistant can draft doctypes from a plain-language description.
welcome_builder_art_aria: The Builder assistant drafts a doctype with typed fields, a reference and a view, then publishes it
welcome_access_body: Roles decide who reads, creates, updates, or deletes — per doctype, down to single fields and rows. Manage roles and assignments in Configure → Access.
welcome_access_art_aria: Roles control read, create, update and delete per doctype, down to single fields and rows
welcome_audit_body: Every change lands in an append-only log: who, what, when, and from where. Open a document's history and roll it back to any earlier state. The full audit sits in Configure → Audit.
welcome_audit_art_aria: Every change is appended to a log with who, when and where; a document is rolled back to an earlier state, and the rollback is logged too
welcome_integrate_body: Hooks run your Lua scripts when documents change or on a schedule. The REST API, API keys, OAuth apps, and an MCP endpoint connect Facet to your stack; your data stays in PostgreSQL. Export a domain as a bundle to move it between environments.
welcome_integrate_art_aria: Lua hooks triggered by changes or a schedule feed Facet; REST API, API keys, OAuth and MCP connect it to your stack; data stays in PostgreSQL; a domain is exported as a bundle
welcome_start_body: Set up your first domain now — it takes minutes. Set your timezone and language in Settings; you can restart this tour there.
welcome_start_art_aria: The six tour topics come together into a check mark: you are all set to create your first domain
settings_welcome_helper: Replay the introduction tour for your account.
settings_welcome_show_helper: Turns the first-run tour back on; it opens on your next sign-in.

dashboard_empty_domains_body: A domain holds one business area of your organization. Create your first domain, or import a bundle from another Facet instance.
